highlights_headline: The v4 preview line advances to Skia m147 with variable fonts, SKPathBuilder, and broader platform support.
highlights_body: It adds animated WebP encoding, color font palettes, explicit surface sampling, and new stream and GPU APIs. Preview consumers should note the new SKPathBuilder migration, the .NET 8 floor for WebAssembly native assets, and the assembly-version change.

breaking.title: GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo moves to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo
breaking.body: GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo now uses GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo. Move code to the correctly cased type; the legacy type no longer provides IEquatable, Equals, or equality operators.

breaking.title: WebAssembly native assets now require .NET 8
breaking.body: Native assets for the Emscripten versions used by .NET 6 and .NET 7 are removed. Upgrade Blazor WebAssembly and Uno Platform WebAssembly projects to .NET 8 or later.

breaking.title: Assembly version advances to 4.147.0.0
breaking.body: SkiaSharp.dll moves from assembly version 3.119.0.0 to 4.147.0.0. Update strong-name binding redirects and any checks pinned to the 3.x assembly version.

bullets.lead: Skia advances from m119 to m147
bullets.detail: The bundled engine incorporates newer codec orientation handling, HDR and wide-gamut improvements, color-aware filters, and accumulated raster and filter corrections.

bullets.lead: SKPathBuilder becomes the path construction API
bullets.detail: SKPathBuilder wraps the immutable-path model introduced upstream, while existing SKPath mutation methods remain available with obsolete warnings for migration.

bullets.lead: Default typeface resolution moves to the managed layer
bullets.detail: SKTypeface.Default now resolves through SKFontManager with an empty-typeface fallback, preventing Android API 36 startup crashes and adding SKTypeface.Empty and IsEmpty.

bullets.lead: Variable fonts and color font palettes
bullets.detail: SKTypeface and HarfBuzzSharp gain APIs for variation axes, named instances, design coordinates, palette selection, and per-color overrides.
New SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface overloads accept SKSamplingOptions so callers can control filtering when compositing surfaces.

bullets.lead: Animated WebP encoding and stream-backed SKData
bullets.detail: SKWebpEncoder can encode frame sequences, while SKStream.GetData returns the backing SKData when a stream can expose it without copying.

bullets.lead: New document, GPU, mask filter, and color APIs
bullets.detail: Adds SKDocument.CreateXps options, per-resource GRContext.Flush overloads, SKMaskFilter.CreateShader, SKColorSpace.CreateCicp, and new HDR color types.

bullets.lead: SKPath finalization no longer depends on builder collection order
bullets.detail: Disposal avoids flushing a builder after finalization has begun, preventing a native crash when SKPathBuilder is collected first.

bullets.lead: Variable-font spans and glyph checks are hardened
bullets.detail: Undersized variation spans now follow Skia's all-or-nothing semantics correctly, and byte-span ContainsGlyphs no longer recurses until a stack overflow.

bullets.lead: Android SKGLView survives navigation and tab switches
bullets.detail: Reattached GL views retain their dimensions instead of creating a zero-sized surface that remains blank.

bullets.lead: NanoServer starts without a system font manager
bullets.detail: Windows NanoServer uses an empty font manager when DirectWrite and GDI are unavailable, avoiding an access violation during first use.
Native packages add linux-bionic x64 and arm64 assets plus tizen-x64 and tizen-arm64 support.

bullets.lead: Apple library target frameworks use the base 26.0 workload
bullets.detail: Apple NuGet assets target 26.0 rather than 26.2, allowing consumers to build with any compatible Xcode 26 workload.
The packages retain Emscripten assets for .NET 8 and later and report a clear build error on unsupported .NET 6 and .NET 7 projects.

v4.147.0-preview.1.1.summary: Advances Skia through m147 and adds SKPathBuilder, variable fonts, color font palettes, explicit surface sampling, managed typeface resolution, and new Linux and Tizen assets.

v4.147.0-preview.2.1.summary: Adds animated WebP encoding and SKStream.GetData, fixes the SKPath finalizer crash, and broadens Apple workload compatibility.

v4.147.0-preview.3.1.summary: Requires .NET 8 or later for WebAssembly native assets, adds HBColor and missing public wrappers, and refreshes bundled image, font, and compression libraries.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.6 adds variable-font and color-palette APIs, introduces HBColor with correct channel semantics, and extends native assets to Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen.
